content:
- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.0) — reduce forecast by 2–5% relative to recent highs.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes — adjust downward by 3–8% if sentiment drops below -0.5.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below peak of prior 3–5 day range.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 14-day moving average, reduce by 1–3% per day until convergence.
- Lagged overreaction: if sentiment is negative but forecast is still high, subtract 1–2% per day for each day of lagged sentiment negativity.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are prone to overconfidence — apply 5–10% downward bias if sentiment is neutral or negative over last 7 days.
